translations.text: Give me, O great God, in this world (it is no concealment), against the pains of the plagues, vehement waves of tears.
Let a vessel reach me at speed (let it not be poor [?]), so that I may come alone, early, past every danger of betrayal [?].
Alas, O holy Christ, that there is no stream on my cheek, as you gave the flood to the poor tender woman.
Alas for every limb, that there is no stream over my breast, so that tonight there might be a washing for my heart and my body.
For the sake of every venerable elder who left his home behind, for the sake of your bright kingdom, for the sake of your passage on the cross,
for the sake of everyone who has wept for his sin in this world: my iniquity, O living God, may I lament it.
For the sake of your great goodness, for the sake of your sovereignty without sorrow, suddenly, swiftly give me a well of tears.
O my beloved, O God, into my heart your blood [?]; tears for me, O God, who will give them but you? Give!
